messages:
alex: quick RFC follow-up — propose we deprecate the ?format=... query param in favor of content-negotiation via Accept header. target ~8w migration. thoughts?
maria: +1 for Accept. cleaner and standard. ops note: CDN/edge caching will need Vary handling though.
sam: can gateway synthesize Accept from the old param so clients don't break? that would buy time.
alex: yes — plan is a gateway shim that maps format -> Accept. fallback order: Accept header (explicit) -> ?format param -> default application/redwood+json. also add Vary: Accept on responses.
harry: Vary: Accept can explode caches. can we instead set a vendor media-type like application/vnd.redwood.chat+json so caches are still reasonable?
maria: vendor mime type is fine. also we should emit a deprecation signal header so we can measure who still hits format param (e.g., X-Redwood-Deprecated: format-param).
sam: sketch of shim (pseudo):
```
# gateway pseudo
mapping = {"chat":"application/vnd.redwood.chat+json", "text":"application/redwood+json"}
if req.query.format:
  req.headers["Accept"] = mapping[req.query.format]
  req.headers["X-Redwood-Deprecated"] = "format-param"
```
This lets backends be unchanged.
alex: rollout proposal: 1) implement shim (canary) 2) collect telemetry 3) enable an opt-in strict mode via header X-Format-Strict: true for canaries 4) after 8w, flip waves to reject format param (return 400 + migration hint)
maria: add SDKs to log warnings when they still send format param. also docs + migration guide.
harry: streaming consideration: if clients use ?format=stream/text we need to map to text/event-stream or server-sent events mime. add tests for SSE frames.
sam: agreed, add mapping for streaming: format=stream -> Accept: text/event-stream and test roundtrip with chunked framing.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for arch-gateway at 2025-03-12 18:00 UTC :rocket:
harry: we should also add a short-lived compatibility header X-Redwood-Accept-From-Query: true so edge logs can filter requests rewritten by shim.
alex: good call. I'll open the follow-up PR with exact header names, mapping table, and the telemetry events to emit. tagging @maria @sam for review. :thumbsup:
maria: ack, will review the PR today.
